title: It Is Written
devotional: When Jesus was tempted in the wilderness, He answered with the Word of God. Scripture was not something He used only during peaceful moments. He knew it and brought it into the battle. You can do the same. When temptation comes, emotions can become loud and confusing. God's Word gives you something solid to stand on. The goal is not simply to memorize verses so you can repeat them. It is to know God's truth well enough that you can turn toward it when pressure comes.
mind_check: What lie, excuse, or false promise does temptation often place in your mind?
body_move: Keep your Bible or a Scripture note somewhere you can easily reach when you know you may be vulnerable.
spirit_move: Choose one Bible verse that speaks directly to an area where you struggle. Read it slowly, memorize the key phrase, and pray it over yourself today.
way_out: When temptation tells me __________, God's Word reminds me __________.
prayer: Father, teach me to know Your Word and depend on it when I am under pressure. Help me recognize the lies that temptation brings and remember what You have said. Give me wisdom to apply Scripture, not merely read it. Let Your truth become stronger in my mind than the voice of temptation. Amen.
action: Choose one Scripture verse for your current battle. Write it somewhere visible and read it at least three times today.
